children: Adyen's appointment of a new chief financial officer clears up uncertainty, ING's Thymen Rundberg writes in a note. The Amsterdam-based payments provider named Niclas Neglen, who joins from online-payments company Klarna, as its next finance chief. "The appointment removes uncertainty around the permanent CFO position following the departure of Ethan Tandowsky earlier this year," Rundberg says. Additionally, Neglen appears to be a solid fit given his previous experience, particularly in his recent role as CFO at Klarna. Shares are down 1.7% at 887.20 euros. (najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
